manifest.description: Diagnose Java behavior living on the wrong side of a data-behavior split.
when_to_use: helpers, processors, or services repeatedly mine the same DTO or data holder for domain behavior
getter density is visible but deciding the missing behavior home requires semantic judgment
a correction plan needs behavior relocation or consolidation around a domain concept
anti_patterns: do not use for legitimate framework DTOs with no behavior pressure
do not use for primitive-to-value-object cleanup by itself
do not use on non-Java targets
